# Franny's Farm Table

> From-scratch farm-to-table restaurant on Historic Main Street in downtown Placerville, California. Opened 2023. Everything made in-house daily: soups, artisan bread, desserts, dressings. Local ingredients and El Dorado County wines.

## Facts

- Name: Franny's Farm Table
- Address: 311 Main Street, Placerville, CA 95667
- Phone: (530) 748-3671
- Email: frannysfarmtable@gmail.com
- Website: https://frannysfarmtable.co
- Cuisine: American, from-scratch comfort food, seafood, grill, steak, pasta
- Price range: $$ (entrees roughly $15–$49)
- Founded: 2023
- Setting: Two-floor historic building; upstairs overlooks Main Street
- Amenities: Dog-friendly, wheelchair accessible, free WiFi, wine & beer, gift cards
- Service options: Dine-in, reservations, takeout, delivery
- Gluten-free: GF dinner rolls, sandwich bread, pasta, and burger buns available

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 11 AM – 9 PM
- Saturday–Sunday: 9 AM – 9 PM
- Weekend brunch: Saturday & Sunday, 9 AM – 12 PM

## Popular dishes

- Loaded Mac & Cheese ($24) — corkscrew pasta, melted cheese, bacon, baked; available gluten-free; a guest favorite
- Franny's Burger ($18) — served with fries, GF bun available
- Atlantic Salmon ($36) — pan-seared, served with pea & pancetta risotto
- Chipotle Salad ($22) — a popular salad
- Certified Angus Ribeye ($49) — fingerling potatoes, vegetables, chimichurri
